ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Я знаю, что я не лучший ученик, но мне нравится, когда она меня учит! Ах, прости, Илмерия!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Sue!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Сью!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: No... I'm not going to lose!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Нет... Я не проиграю!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: S-Sue, are you still reading? It's been over an hour!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: С-Сью, ты все еще читаешь? Прошло больше часа!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: You'll give yourself a fever and collapse, pushing yourself so! Stop it, Sue!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: От такого напряжения ты поднимешь себе температуру и упадешь в обморок! Прекрати, Сью!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Hey, that's just mean. It will take more than an hour to make me collapse!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Эй, это просто подло. Чтобы заставить меня рухнуть, понадобится больше часа!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: I guess it might, but what's brought this on so suddenly?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Я думаю, что да, но что заставило это случиться так внезапно?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: I'm worried about Ilmeria. I'm the reason she's so sad...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Я беспокоюсь за Илмерию. Я причина, по которой ей так грустно...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: I can't imagine having any other teacher... We are so lucky to have found her...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Я не могу себе представить, чтобы у меня был другой учитель... Нам так повезло, что мы нашли ее...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: So I'm working to be able to withstand longer sessions of studying, but... uwah!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Так что я работаю над тем, чтобы выдержать более длительные занятия, но... ух!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: ...You can't take any more.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: ...Ты не можешь больше терпеть.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Yeah. My brain is about to melt.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Ага. Мой мозг вот-вот расплавится.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Ah. I'm worthless! A worthless student who only causes trouble for her teacher.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Ах. Я бесполезен! Бесполезная ученица, которая только доставляет неприятности своему учителю.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Sue... Right, I've got an idea!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Сью... Точно, у меня есть идея!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: An idea? What for, a recipe?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Идея? Зачем, рецепт?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: No, an operation. An operation to let our teacher know how we feel!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Нет, операция. Операция, позволяющая нашему учителю узнать, что мы чувствуем!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Ilmeria said it before, didn't she? That she is happy to see her students grow.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Илмерия уже говорила это раньше, не так ли? Что она рада видеть, как растут ее ученики.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: So let's make an incredible item and give it to her! Something to show her how much we've grown!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Так давайте сделаем невероятную вещь и подарим ей! Что-нибудь, чтобы показать ей, насколько мы выросли!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Of course! We're alchemists, after all. Giving her something we've synthesized is the best gift!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Конечно! В конце концов, мы алхимики. Подарить ей то, что мы синтезировали, — лучший подарок!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Well said! Let's think about what we should make, then!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Хорошо сказано! Тогда давайте подумаем, что нам делать!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: We've done it. We've really done it! This isn't going to be easy, either, is it.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Мы сделали это. Мы действительно сделали это! Это тоже будет непросто, не так ли?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: If we're making something for Ilmeria, it has to be cute. This recipe is totally amazing!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Если мы делаем что-то для Илмерии, это должно быть мило. Этот рецепт просто потрясающий!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Yes! These Cute Philosopher's Stones will surely tell her exactly how we feel!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Да! Эти милые философские камни наверняка расскажут ей, что именно мы чувствуем!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Come on then, Sue! For the sake of our cute teacher, let's make the cutest thing we can!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Тогда давай, Сью! Ради нашей милой учительницы давайте сделаем самую милую вещь, какую только сможем!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: You said it! Just you wait and see, teacher!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Ты сказал это! Просто подождите и увидите, учитель!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Teacher! This is for you!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Учитель! Это вам!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Wow! Incredibly cute Philosopher's Stones!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Ух ты! Невероятно милые Философские Камни!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: They look so different, I presume this is an original recipe? Did you two think this up?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Они такие разные, я полагаю, это оригинальный рецепт? Вы двое это придумали?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Yes! We created it together!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Да! Мы создали его вместе!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: I almost can't believe it! But why? Don't tell me...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Я почти не могу в это поверить! Но почему? Не говорите мне...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Hehehe, I think you've worked it out. We wanted to show you how much we've grown.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Хе-хе-хе, я думаю, ты с этим справился. Мы хотели показать вам, насколько мы выросли.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: I know, I'm a bad student. I don't like studying, I can't sit still for ten seconds...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Я знаю, я плохой ученик. Я не люблю учиться, не могу усидеть на месте и десяти секунд...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: But I love learning alchemy from you! I want you to know that!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Но мне нравится учиться у тебя алхимии! Я хочу, чтобы вы это знали!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Suelle...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Сюэль...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Hehe. Other people have taught us, too, but your lessons just calm me down the most.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Хе-хе. Другие люди тоже нас учили, но ваши уроки меня успокаивают больше всего.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: After all, we've grown so much thanks to all the fundamentals you've drummed into us!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: В конце концов, мы так выросли благодаря всем тем основам, которые вы нам вдалбливали!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Lydie!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Лиди!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: You're the best teacher for us, Ilmeria. You should have more confidence!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Ты для нас лучший учитель, Илмерия. Вам следует иметь больше уверенности!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: That's right. Be your normal, confident, kind, gentle and cute self! Please!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Это верно. Будьте нормальным, уверенным в себе, добрым, нежным и милым! Пожалуйста!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Please, Ilmeria! Continue to teach us!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Пожалуйста, Илмерия! Продолжайте нас учить!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Please!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Пожалуйста!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Hold on. Did you think this would make me happy?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Подожди. Ты думал, это сделает меня счастливым?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: W-What? It didn't work?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Ч-Что? Это не сработало?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: B-Because I can't study? Are we going to be kicked out? Are we really going to be kicked out?!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Б-Потому что я не могу учиться? Нас выгонят? Неужели нас действительно выгонят?!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Haha! You dummies. I'm happy. Of course I'm happy! I'm so happy, I want to test you right now!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Хаха! Вы, дураки. Я счастлив. Конечно я рад! Я так рада, хочу проверить тебя прямо сейчас!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Hahahaha! Maybe we can skip that part?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Может, пропустим эту часть?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Hahaha, thank you, both of you. You've blown away all the clouds from my heart.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Ха-ха-ха, спасибо вам обоим. Ты сдул все тучи с моего сердца.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Lydie, Sue... You are the ultimate students.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Лиди, Сью... Вы лучшие ученики.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Teach...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Научите...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Being blessed with such fine students... Ah, how lucky I am!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Иметь таких прекрасных учеников... Ах, как мне повезло!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Hold it! Firis is the best student, and that's a fact!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Держи! Фирис лучшая ученица, и это факт!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: No, that's not right! Escha is definitely a better student than me!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Нет, это не так! Эша определенно учится лучше меня!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: I won't accept that! Lydie and Sue are the best!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Я этого не приму! Лиди и Сью лучшие!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Oh... What's going on here?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Ох... Что здесь происходит?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Ah, well. We were having another teacher and student meeting...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Ах, ну. У нас была очередная встреча учителей и учеников...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: And we got into a fight about which of our students is the most capable...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: И мы поспорили о том, кто из наших учеников самый способный...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Hahaha, I think I see now. But hold on, Firis, you have a student too?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Ха-ха-ха, кажется, теперь я понимаю. Но погоди, Фирис, у тебя тоже есть ученик?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: She does. Enough of this, though. This kind of battle means nothing at all.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Она так и делает. Впрочем, хватит этого. Такая битва вообще ничего не значит.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: That's right. I know it's odd for us to say this, being involved, but everyone has their own...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Это верно. Я знаю, что нам странно говорить это, будучи вовлеченными, но у каждого свое...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: There's no contest. The best student is Sophie, no doubt about it!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Никакого конкурса. Лучшая ученица – Софи, вне всякого сомнения!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Oh... There comes another bias teacher...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Ох... Приходит ещё один учитель по уклону...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Hey, girls, great timing!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Эй, девчонки, отличное время!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Come on, say something! Tell them that you're the best!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Давай, скажи что-нибудь! Скажи им, что ты лучший!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: What? W-We can't do that! It doesn't matter who's the "best", anyway.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Что? М-мы не можем этого сделать! В любом случае, не имеет значения, кто «лучший».

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Everyone
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Yes it does!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Да, это так!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: System
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Yes it does!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Да, это так!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: System
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Yes it does!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Да, это так!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Uwah!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Ува!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Very well. We aren't going to settle this today. Let's wait a little longer and see what happens.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Очень хорошо. Мы не собираемся решать этот вопрос сегодня. Подождем еще немного и посмотрим, что произойдет.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Good idea. Considering Escha's incredible potential, this should be settled pretty soon!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Хорошая идея. Учитывая невероятный потенциал Эши, этот вопрос должен быть решен довольно скоро!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Don't write yourself off so soon, Firis! You're still growing yourself!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Не списывай себя со счетов так рано, Фирис! Ты все еще растешь!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: And you're one to talk, Sophie! Your talent shows no signs of slowing down!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: И ты одна, чтобы поговорить, Софи! Ваш талант не проявляет никаких признаков замедления!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Let's not get caught up in this, Lydie...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Давай не будем ввязываться в это, Лиди...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Yeah. I can't see this ever being settled.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Ага. Я не думаю, что этот вопрос когда-либо будет решен.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Hah! None of you get it, do you? The alchemists with the greatest potential for the future are...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Ха! Никто из вас этого не понимает, не так ли? Алхимики с наибольшим потенциалом на будущее – это...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: The two who will become the greatest in the land, taught by a genius alchemist in her own right!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Двое, которые станут величайшими в стране, которых обучает гениальный алхимик!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Lydie and Sue! The only possible choices! Isn't that right, girls?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Лиди и Сью! Единственный возможный выбор! Не так ли, девочки?
